metaTitle: Custom Full Color Adhesive Notepads | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color adhesive notepads for your brand. Perfect for marketing, reminders, and notes. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full color printing on adhesive notepads lets you reproduce logos, photos, or detailed graphics with sharp, vibrant results. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color captures gradients and fine details, making your notepad a mini billboard that sticks. Marketing directors use these for promotional giveaways, while HR managers rely on them for onboarding reminders. Choose from sizes like 3" x 3" or 6" x 4" and sheet counts from 25 to 100. The adhesive backing keeps your message visible on desks, monitors, or notebooks.
